{{For|the ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in [[Far Madding]]|Guardian}}{{dablink|For other uses of the word "gate," see [[Gate]].}}
'''Guardian of the Southern Gate''' is a [[title]] of the [[Amadicia]]n monarch. While Amadicia is one of the southern nations, it, like [[Tarabon]], doesn't sit on the [[Aryth Ocean]]. Instead, it is separated from the ocean and the [[Shadow Coast]] by a large streach of land. It may be that this is the "southern gate" mentioned in the title. The last known holder of the title was [[King]] [[Ailron]].
